versions.changelog: v1.4.0 Evolve First: adds opt-in evolve-or-forge routing with decide_skill_action, fitness scoring, skill_forge.py decide, forge --prefer-evolve, synthetic feedback audit entries tagged source=forge-routing, and six routing release checks. Signed approval and replay regression remain authoritative downstream.

v1.3.0 Benchmark Pipeline: adds deterministic benchmark cases across academic/product/integration/script/workflow profiles, enforces validation/eval/runtime budgets, adds make benchmark, updates make package-check to include benchmarks, and adds a dedicated GitHub Actions Benchmarks workflow with benchmark-results artifacts.

v1.2.0 Quality Refinement: anchored scaffold descriptions to user triggers, made workflow section milestone-grade, scoped numbered-step scoring to workflow sections, expanded case-insensitive extraneous-doc validation, allowed version/license/author frontmatter, and raised release coverage to 26 checks.

v1.0.1 Forge Console patch: normalize demo JSON pass-through, remove duplicate forge_console shim, expose install/uninstall bot-token env forwarding, clarify doctor approval-secret source, harden git clean detection, and avoid duplicate source-repo secret scans in release-check.

v1.0.0 Forge Console: promote Skill Forge into a product-level console with doctor, demo, forge, evolve, install, uninstall, feedback, replay, release-check, and version commands. Preserve signed-gate install safety, add installed-package smoke support, document ClawHub console usage, and extend release checks to cover console doctor and demo flows.

v0.5.0 Signed Gate: replace self-attested Telegram approval with HMAC-bound install approval tokens; block dry-run approvals from mutating state; add source hash and missing-source guards; compare replay baseline vs candidate for regression gating; strengthen redaction, manifest locking, runtime errors, scheduler uninstall safety, and release checks.
Tighten evolution update path safety, add traversal regression checks, and reduce false-positive secret wording.
Initial public preview with Telegram-gated installs, hidden evaluation, replay regression checks, release checks, and optional Somnia support.
